notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
Hello Metamorphic players! I've finally managed to update Metamorphic. A number of changes have been made including:

- Players will no longer be able to physically push morphed objects
- Levels 5, 7, 8 and 12 have been subtly redesigned according to feedback
- Level 6 was replaced with a new level to account for the the small change in mechanics
- Level 11 was refurbished to better teach the player
- Tutorials should correctly appear in level 5
- A multitude of other bug fixes

I apologize for the how long its taken to get this update out, if you were dissatisfied with the original version of Metamorphic, I'd encourage you to try the updated levels!

Hope you all have happy holidays and a great New Year!
